references.text: The basic regulation that one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour shall be offered as a grain offering with each lamb.
The same amount of flour (one-tenth of an ephah) per lamb is mentioned in connection with the new moon offerings.
Identical wording regarding one-tenth of an ephah of flour for each of the seven lambs at the Passover festival.
The same offering regulation concerning one-tenth of an ephah of flour per lamb at the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot).
Repetition of the same offering regulation for the lambs on the Day of Atonement.
The same amount of flour per lamb prescribed for the Feast of Tabernacles.
The original regulation concerning one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering together with the lamb.
Two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour are mentioned as a grain offering, illustrating the general principles for grain offerings with flour.
